identity.title: Make language changes and ComboBox-heavy UI immediately legible

origin.summary: The owner reported an apparent Korean-to-English freeze, clipped ComboBox text, slow UI animation, transiently invisible selected values, and an unclear full-screen lower boundary, and requested a complete ComboBox audit plus development.

state.current_summary: PL-0031 is resolved after the product-owner evidence reopened the incomplete audit and the corrected inspection proved all 27 controls, all seven style owners, and actual Wide, Compact, and popup English text.

objective.summary: Language changes complete without an apparent freeze or blank selected values, every ComboBox remains legible in its supported states, UI popups avoid slow decorative motion, and the maximized Shell has a clearly separated bottom status surface.
constraints: Preserve explicit Preview, Publish, Run, recipe, source, ROI, result, and active-layer contracts.
Use the existing graphite semantic theme and support Wide 1920 x 1040 and Compact 1280 x 760.
Do not expand into camera, PLC, robot, cloud, or production-line control.
Do not commit, push, version, or publish without explicit owner authorization.

criteria.text: One language change raises one all-properties localization notification, preserves selected ComboBox values, updates Korean and English presentation, and meets the focused responsiveness budget in the current Release EXE.

All 27 audited ComboBoxes use the shared themed geometry with no undersized declaration, and normal, focus, hover, selected, disabled/read-only, validation, and open-popup states remain legible where applicable.
The two explicit popup animations are removed and no app-owned XAML animation remains in the Shell, Viewer, or log surfaces.
A semantic bottom status surface clearly separates the full-screen lower boundary and remains visible without clipping in current-build Wide and Compact Korean and English evidence.
Focused verification, proportional Release build, required UI smoke matrix, documentation, ledger validation, link checks, and diff hygiene pass.

milestones.summary: ComboBox inventory and shared geometry correction
Motion reduction and bottom status surface

context.summary: The task is a presentation and responsiveness slice; it must not execute inspection or mutate authored state.

artifacts.summary: Current-build before/after screenshots, monitor evidence, timing reports, and smoke outputs.

evidence.observation: ThreeDLocalization contained 538 property names and formerly raised one notification per name; the corrected source raises one empty-name all-properties event. The full XAML inventory contains 27 ComboBoxes, no explicit Height or MinHeight below 30 px, and no remaining PopupAnimation, Storyboard, BeginStoryboard, or DoubleAnimation request.

Final current Release verification passed 93/93. One language switch emitted one empty-name notification, completed in 8.39 ms, preserved selected palette and auxiliary content, found 27 ComboBoxes with zero undersized overrides, found zero explicit popup animations, and confirmed the 30 px bound bottom status contract.

Current Release Wide 1920x1040 English Height Image and Compact 1280x760 Korean open-popup smokes exited successfully on the dynamically selected leftmost monitor. Selected values, non-empty range text, popup items, rendered Height Image, and the bottom status boundary were visible; the Height Image report confirmed view-only state with no recipe change or inspection run.
Final Release build passed with zero warnings and zero errors; 44 changed-document local links had zero missing targets; PL-0031 validated as Proofline v2; and git diff --check passed.

The current themed language ComboBox renders the English selection with the lower glyph area clipped. Direct current Release inspection also shows the same English glyph issue in the open popup, so height and identity assertions alone do not prove legibility.

Current Release verification passed 95/95. It laid out the actual English selection as Wide English 49 x 18.6, Compact EN 18 x 18.6, and popup English 44.8 x 18.6 with no clip; audited 27 ComboBoxes, four ComboBox style owners, and three ComboBoxItem style owners; and found no undersized tag/style setter, unsafe style owner, or explicit popup animation.

Current Release Wide 1920 x 1040 and Compact 1280 x 760 English smokes exited 0 and produced acceptable screenshots on the dynamically selected leftmost monitor. Both window rectangles intersected monitor bounds -2400,456,0,1806. Direct current-build review also showed complete Korean and English text in the open Wide and Compact language popups.

The final proportional Release build passed with zero warnings and zero errors. Changed-document local links passed 44/44, current changed documentation records the reopening and correction, and git diff --check passed.

events.summary: All five PL-0031 criteria passed with current source, focused verification, actual Release UI evidence, documentation, and hygiene checks.
Product-owner evidence disproved the prior all-ComboBox legibility closure, so PL-0031 was reopened.
The owner-reported lower English glyph clipping is corrected and the replacement source, rendered-text, Release EXE, documentation, and hygiene gates pass.
